subject: Privileged role rationalization + SCIM evidence handoff
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@aurorahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@aurorahealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 11:03:12 -0400
Subject: Access evidence request — privileged roles + SCIM samples for SIG/SOC2

Hi Aditya,

Aurora's SOC 2 audit team is asking for a short bundle covering privileged role ownership and provisioning controls for Redwood's tenant used in our PoC. Specifically we need:

- A list of all roles classified as "privileged" (admin, org-admin, service-admin, billing-admin) with a short business justification for each.
- Role owner (email) and latest attestation (or an owner attestation if none exists).
- SCIM sync evidence: a sample of SCIM deltas for the last 7 days (create/update/delete) for a small sample of users tied to those roles.
- Two SAML assertion examples (one interactive sign-in, one automated service account flow) with attribute mappings redacted by default.

Deadline: auditor requested artifacts by COB Wednesday, 5/18. If you have a lightweight attestation template we can accept that and get owners to sign.

Let me know if we should expect any PII redaction guidance from our side or if Redwood will deliver redacted samples.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Park
Security Manager, Aurora Health
emily.park@aurorahealth.com

---
Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 11:47:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Access evidence request — privileged roles + SCIM samples for SIG/SOC2

Emily — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver the requested artifacts. High-level plan below; details and attachments follow.

Planned deliverables (target delivery by 2027-05-18 COB):
- privileged_role_inventory_20270516.csv: role name, classification (privileged/normal), justification, role_owner, last_owner_attestation_date, linked_service_accounts.
- scim-sync-sample-7day.json: anonymized SCIM delta events (create/update/delete) covering a 7-day window for 20 sample users mapped to privileged roles.
- Two SAML assertion examples (we will redact PII and return SAML NameID as hashed token).
- owner-attestation-template.docx: short attestation text for owners to confirm minimal access and business justification.

Redaction approach: by default we will hash any PII (email/userids) and include a mapping table that shows hashed_id -> internal user_id (for auditor use only). If Aurora prefers to supply a redaction rule (e.g., keep corporate emails intact), say so and we'll adjust.

Workback: Ben will extract the role inventory and tag service accounts; Priyom will run the SCIM delta export at the tenant level and prepare redacted samples; Naomi will run the SAML assertion capture and prepare the two examples. I will assemble the bundle and circulate the owner attestation for signatures.

We will deliver a "canary" packet with sanitized CSV + one SCIM sample by EOD 5/17 so auditors can start reviewing sooner. Full bundle by EOD 5/18.

Links/attachments: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSampleDriveLink (will populate with artifacts).

If that timeline works for your team, I'll start the internal work items now.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Lead, Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: privileged_role_inventory_20270516.csv (stub), owner-attestation-template.docx (stub)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 May 2027 08:14:22 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Action items for Aurora evidence (RELINF-4521)

Team — quick and pragmatic asks so we can hit the 5/18 auditor deadline. Please reply inline with status.

Ben — please produce the CSV export with these columns: role_id, role_name, classification, justification_text (one-liner), role_owner_email, last_attestation_date, linked_service_accounts_count. Mark any roles with no owner as "orphan" and flag for remediation. Target: EOD 5/17.

Priyom — run a SCIM delta export scoped to the Aurora tenant and produce a 7-day sample in JSON. Include create/update/delete events and timestamps. Redact emails by hashing using SHA256 (prefix with "hash:"). Provide explanation of the hashing algorithm in a short README. Target: morning 5/17 so we can include a sample with the canary.

Naomi — capture two SAML assertion samples: (1) interactive user login (AuthnRequest flow) and (2) service-to-service token exchange (machine account). Strip raw assertion children carrying PII and replace NameID with hashed id. Provide attribute mapping table (attr name -> description).

Notes: keep artifacts in the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSampleDriveLink and attach as stubs in the email bundle. I will own the attestation circulation and final packaging.

JIRA: RELINF-4521 — link the exports there and mark as "evidence for Aurora SOC2".

Thanks — Adi

---
Aditya Rao

Subject: Re: Privileged role rationalization + SCIM evidence handoff

Aditya — thank you, this plan looks good and the canary by 5/17 will be helpful. A few quick clarifications from the auditor's side:

- We prefer hashing of user emails instead of redaction so mapping is preserved for auditor verification; your SHA256-based "hash:" prefix is fine.
- For the attestation template, auditors want a short line that the owner confirms the role is necessary and that least-privilege has been considered. If you can include a checkbox list (access justification, last review date, compensating controls) that would speed signoff.
- We will not accept any raw PII in the SAML samples; hashed NameIDs are acceptable. If you can add a short attestation note from Redwood confirming hashing and chain of custody for the artifacts, we can include that with our submission.

Please send the canary packet when ready and loop in your procurement contact if there will be any additional formalities.

Best,
Emily
Security Manager, Aurora Health
emily.park@aurorahealth.com
